title: Garmin Just Made Your Watch Log Your DOG's Runs 🐶
description:
Your Garmin can now log your dog's runs. 🐶

Garmin's Q4 2026 software update adds dog profiles and dog activity types to more than 20 watches, from the fēnix 9 and Forerunner 970 down to the $249.99 Forerunner 70, plus Venu 4, vivoactive 6 and Instinct 3. You add your dog's profile in Garmin Connect and tag it on your walks and runs; a "Run with Dog" activity tags it automatically, and there are dog badges. Garmin counts nine new features in this free update.

The catch: it doesn't track the dog itself (there's no tracker on the dog), it just tags your dog on your workout. And Garmin says the rollout will take the coming weeks, so not every watch gets it at once.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 58/100 → SPEC. Grab it if your dog is your running buddy.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
